title: Project inventory
boundary: Import the known project list and preserve its original names, order and root paths as provenance. Choose actual trusted directories on the target separately. This does not copy worktrees, trust decisions, vendor metadata or authentication.
noSources: No projects were found in the known registry.
failed: The project inventory could not be confirmed. Rediscover if the source changed.
changed: The original project catalog changed or expired. Discover again before selecting.
unknown: The preview reply was not confirmed. Open migration records to reconcile; do not repeat the request blindly.
partial: I understand the registry is incomplete and want to continue with the explicitly selected known records.
registerBoundary: Enter an existing directory on this target device. Registration is an explicit Native workspace operation, separate from the imported association. It preserves user labels and requires independent trust before mapping. Undo removes only the imported association, not this registered workspace or its files.
registrationUnknown: Registration was not confirmed. Refresh the target list to reconcile; do not repeat it with a new identity.
name: Target workspace name
updateRequired: Update the target to use project inventory and mapping.
registrationConflict: This directory is already registered. Refresh and choose the existing workspace; its label and roots were preserved.
